title: Minecraft's Studio Sold for 2.5 Billion Dollars in 2014

scenes.text: A game from 2009 sold for two and a half billion dollars.
In 2014, Microsoft bought Mojang, the studio behind Minecraft.
The game was only five years old.
It already had over 100 million downloads on PC alone.
Nearly 90 percent of paying PC players had logged in within the past year.
Players built blocks. Microsoft bought the whole world.

description:
A game from 2009 sold for two and a half billion dollars.
In September 2014 Microsoft announced it would buy Mojang, the studio behind Minecraft, for 2.5 billion dollars, five years after the game launched.
What was your first Minecraft build? Tell us below.
